items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: There was like that, what’s that, all of the oh Fats Navarro, people like that.

ctx.x: I see. So what would your grandmother have thought if you played a boogie woogie record in her house?

Oh my God she’d — I hear her today. She told me, she said, “Don’t ever go to those reels.” She called them “reels.” R-E-E-L-S, which meant the movies at the time. There was like that, what’s that, all of the oh Fats Navarro, people like that. Right? And apparently at the time, in Tulsa, you know, jazz music and rock, and rhythm & blues were just, you know, really the substance of entertainment for the entire community. And I think she had had an encounter with one of the people in the family that hung out at the…
I see. Yeah, this would have been late 40s, early 50s?
